limitations: The prior overlay is retained as a comparator; new native spacing, forced junctions and planned sites control this revision.
Unresolved gap exceptions do not grant walking coverage, new sites, field acceptance or fare demand.

policy.basis: Price dry intermediate platforms in the remaining long gaps after the actual line-crossing platforms are restored. Keep ordinary infill between 1.2 and 2.0 km apart; a 1.5 km maximum cannot divide some new 1.99 km gaps without violating the minimum spacing. Distinct crossing/terminal platforms retain explicit site-review gates. Improve corridor access and distributed charging; retain the existing fleet conservatively and require complete nominal/degraded screens. Footprints, land, structures, access and ridership remain independent release gates.
